output.summary: The group's 17-18 minute ticket time is a board-approved tradeoff of the 2024 scratch menu redesign. It was projected at 18 minutes with a 19-minute ceiling. It is stable, and it coincides with higher satisfaction, same-store sales and check size. The Pellston benchmark excludes scratch kitchens, so the 12-minute comparison is invalid. Riverside's spike comes from the unfilled saute/pasta vacancy, with transfer requests deferred by group operations. Why the cook left is disputed and unresolved. Par-cooked standardization and a ticket-time bonus are harmful (the 2023 audit found bumped tickets under a similar incentive). Firing the GM is unsupported. Restore Riverside staffing and add alerts.
